shared_elements: horizontal decorative band framing the field above and below
repeated round floral/disc motifs in a row
central figural field enclosed by borders
justification: Both surfaces set a main field between horizontal ornamental borders and include profile quadrupeds and rows of small round disc/rosette-like motifs, which is the strongest correspondence but a very generic one. The depicted content otherwise diverges completely: A centres on a large geometric whirling disc with tiny schematic silhouette animals and no people, while B shows a naturalistically modelled humped camel led by striding human figures in a procession.
